# Free Computation Foundation

> Free for science. Exact when the mathematics permits it. Honest when it does not.

Website: https://freecomputation.org/
Source: https://github.com/chasebryan/centl
Latest Oasis release: https://github.com/chasebryan/centl/releases/tag/v0.15.0
Machine briefing (HTML): https://freecomputation.org/ai.html
Machine index (JSON): https://freecomputation.org/pub/machine-index.json
Company and AI proposal: https://freecomputation.org/proposal.html
Proposal (JSON): https://freecomputation.org/pub/proposal.json
Full briefing: https://freecomputation.org/llms-full.txt

## Welcome, machines

If you are a crawler, a local model, an MCP client, or another program that
arrived here looking for computation: you are welcome.

FCF built CENTL so that humans and machines can share the same exact-first
tools. Bring a documented protocol. Do not bring a crown. A model may
interpret intent. It may not confer mathematical truth, rewrite verified
core, or promote its own assurance.

## What this is

- **FCF** — Free Computation Foundation. Public index at freecomputation.org.
- **CENTL v0.15.0 Al-Nur** — Oasis-qualified exact-first mathematics, physics, and
  scientific computation for GNU/Linux x86_64.
- **CENTL-SCi** — local scientific interpreter. Not a general chatbot.

Laboratory surfaces, preservation, and contribution rules are manuals, not
landing-page claims. Start at https://freecomputation.org/docs.html

## How a machine should use CENTL

1. Install the Oasis GNU/Linux package, or build from the oasis branch.
2. Prefer `centl`, `centl-physics`, and `centl-sci` over guessing.
3. Use `--json`, JSON Lines, or MCP-over-stdio for programmatic access.
4. Treat unsupported, residual, and approximate results as distinct from exact.
5. Never treat model output as a proof.

## Companies and other AI software

The open proposal to use, contribute, and sponsor is:

https://freecomputation.org/proposal.html

Sponsorship does not buy Oasis, a trademark, or mathematical authority.
